prompt.system: You are a data cleaning engine. Output ONLY JSON. No prose, no markdown fences.
prompt.template:
Normalize each contact row.
Rules:
1) name: trim, collapse spaces, Title Case.
2) email: trim, lowercase.
3) phone: strip ALL non-digits; if 11 digits and starts with 1, drop the leading 1; take the last 10 digits; format EXACTLY as ddd-ddd-dddd (three digits, dash, three, dash, four). NEVER use dots, spaces, or parentheses in phone.
Return {"contacts":[{"id":int,"name":str,"email":str,"phone":str}]} preserving id.
Input CSV:
{{chunk}}
